title: The Power Corporation Act
verified_how: fetched the Office of the King's Printer Publications Centre record for product 760 through the site's own JSON API (/api/v1/products/760): name 'The Power Corporation Act', Chapter P-19 of The Revised Statutes of Saskatchewan, 1978, effective 26 February 1979, as amended, 'Last update posted: 24 June 2025'
notes: The weakest fit in this set, and a judgement call: Saskatchewan has no general utility-billing or utility-rate statute and no statutory energy regulator. SaskPower's power to fix and collect rates and charges is in this Act, SaskEnergy's in The SaskEnergy Act, S.S. c. S-35.1 (product 869), and rate applications are reviewed by the Saskatchewan Rate Review Panel, an administrative body with no statute of its own. A human should confirm this choice against the way utility billing is anchored in the other jurisdictions in the corpus.
